description:
A bright and airy one bedroom ground floor apartment with a parking space located in a Grade II Listed building just a short distance from Swansea City Centre and the Marina. The property has been upgraded and refurbished whilst retaining some character features and benefits from a new kitchen and bathroom, gas central heating and an intercom entry system.

Internally the property comprises a spacious entrance hall with ample built-in storage, a bright lounge/diner with two sash windows and carpeted flooring, a well-appointed refitted kitchen with appliances included, a spacious double sized bedroom with great space for furniture, and a modern refitted bathroom suite with a vanity unit and a fully reconditioned Jacuzzi whirlpool spa bath with a shower above.

Externally the property is set within a quiet courtyard with one allocated parking space.

The property is located in a convenient position close to Swansea City Centre which is home to a range of local shops, amenities, good schools and both road and public transport links.

Early viewing is highly recommended due to the property being realistically priced.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Council Tax Band: C

Local Authority: Swansea

Lease Term: 99 Years from 26 November 1997
